messages.text: Father Miguel mentioned the tamale sale at the council meeting. said last year was the best ever
almost 4,000. I was not expecting that. we sold out by 1pm on the second day
it went to the youth group right
yes. new instruments for the group and a deposit on the van for the summer retreat. I want to hit 4,500 this December if I can find two more volunteer teams
I will coordinate the volunteers if you do the tamales
ok the cramps this month were the worst I remember in a long time
not that bad but i was in bed until 2pm. couldn't stand up
did you go to dr chen about this
yeah she mentioned a specialist could do a better workup but i haven't done it
the upfront cost. $400 just to walk in plus whatever imaging they order
i know. maybe after we finish the chase card
did you watch the Vatican synod coverage
yes. they keep dancing around it and not saying what we all know
yes. I have watched women run this parish for 20 years. Dona Rosa ran everything. Father Miguel will tell you himself. why should the collar matter
I told Father Miguel at confession last month. he did not disagree
I was looking at the Gaby quince photos today. I still cannot believe how it came out
140 people. three food stations. every single thing ran on time. I am still proud of that one
my tia cried at the waltz. you planned that part too
the dance was the thing I was most nervous about. Gaby has two left feet bless her
you have no idea how much that meant to me. under budget and everything
we came in at 3,800. I kept the spreadsheet if you ever want to use it for reference
You following the Gwinnett school board race at all? Primary filing deadline was yesterday.
I saw. checking who filed. there is one Republican I actually looked up and he seems reasonable on the bilingual ed stuff
You would be the only person I know who would say that.
I vote for the person not the letter, at least for county stuff. state and federal I basically know where I land
Fair. I respect it even if I land differently.
I am a 7 out of 10 on the party thing if we are being honest. the other 3 is for surprises
Lupita asked me today why you know how to do everything
I said because your mom has been running things since she was ten
that is basically true. Adriana was a baby, Javier was three, I was heating tortillas and signing Tomas permission slips because Mama and Papa were both working doubles
and you never complained about it
I did not know there was anything to complain about. it was just what we did
better. did the yoga this morning, walked paco twice, made conchas for the kids
all three in one day? you were really struggling huh
yeah. yesterday was rough. but the baking helped more than anything
i already did. that was actually first this morning before anyone woke up
hey. can I ask you something. it's about Mateo
on the bus in December. another kid said something to him. something really bad
the worst word. the n-word. Mateo is not Black but the kid used it at him
Maria, I'm sorry. How is he now
better. we met with the principal. it was handled. but he was really shaken for a long time
still processing. that's why I wanted to talk to you
comadre I found the photos from Decatur. june 2020. the ones with the signs
look at us. I was so scared and also so sure we were right
remember the walk from the parking garage? Keisha kept saying stay hydrated
and then it poured. I still have the shirt somewhere
Hector was moving the furniture in the garage today and I just held my breath the whole time
yes. five weeks without him working almost broke us. the GoFundMe you did kept us going, that and Javier paying the light bill
you would have done the same for me
I know. but I hate that we needed it. savings was gone in three weeks
made the Chase payment today. $250 this month
about $2,550 now. started at around $2,800 in January
24%. it's a mess. I'm throwing everything over the minimum at it
15 more months if I don't slip
Mama si ya lo llame, el medico dice que el resultado esta bien por ahora
AY GRACIAS A DIOS. Y EN INGLES QUE DIJO
que el nivel esta en 7.1, dentro del rango. te voy a traducir la nota del doctor cuando llegue esta tarde
ya se. nos vemos a las 5
Hey — did you see the Gwinnett special referendum is Tuesday? School board funding measure.
yes already on my calendar, 6:30am, Berkmar
Of course you have it on your calendar. I still have to remind half the PTA.
I check the Gwinnett elections page like every month now. after November I told myself I was not missing anything, not even the tiny ones
That tracks. I saw you registered people at the fall festival too. Nice numbers.
140 people last year. still thinking about some of them, hope they actually showed up in november
okay. Hector cleared about 3,800 after taxes. I had 1,214 from the arts center and one private event. so just over 5,000 total
yes. January was lower, about 4,600. and if Hector has a slow week in summer we can drop to 3,800. I budget for the middle number
the Lilburn Mamas group is sharing that SlimTea thing again. the one from Brazil
I already looked that one up last October. the seller account harvests phone numbers and the ingredient list has a compound that interacts with blood pressure meds
how do you even find that
I search the brand name plus FDA warning and supplement database. takes ten minutes. then I post what I found in the group before people buy
I might. if the library would host it
good! right ankle held up the whole session. zapateado full speed
yeah. six weeks in that boot felt like six months
i remember you could barely put weight on it
one bad landing. totally my fault
i think so. dr chen said just watch it on the zapateado
comadre you are on Facebook at 10pm again
I posted the arts center flyer and now I am in three arguments in the community group
one more comment. someone said the tamale fundraiser was too expensive and I have receipts
you have been on there for two hours haven't you
I manage the arts center page, it counts as work
went this morning, in and out by 7:40. you should have gone
was it the school thing? I did not know about it
every single time. I keep sending you the reminders
you said that in 2024 too and then called me at 7:45pm asking where to go
Did you see the Stacey Abrams interview on the voting rights stuff
I watched the whole thing. she lost but she built something that lasted. that is more impressive to me than the win would have been
I am a practical person. you judge organizers by what they leave standing, not by one election night
the kids want a dog so bad. how is Paco with the kids
he's perfect. chihuahua mix, we got him from the Humane Society two years ago
never. he's attached to Mateo mostly. Mateo also has a betta fish, Ronaldo
of course he named it Ronaldo
it was between that and Messi and I am NOT having that in my house
my cousin got a new one for the house. her husband insisted
ugh. Hector does this every so often. wants one in the nightstand I say absolutely not
same argument every house in this county apparently
kids in the house. Mateo is curious about everything. no.
for a few months then brings it up again. I think he heard about a break-in near Five Forks
you ever feel like your brain just won't stop running
nothing happened. thats the thing. i just spent 45 min spiraling about the Chase card even though i paid $250 this month
maria that's been your thing since I've known you
i know. its just worse at night
not yet. will do it after this
you seem different at the arts center events than you do with me. more on.
also maybe think about talking to someone? like actually
also maybe think about talking to someone? like actually
I am. with you I can say I am scared or tired or I do not know. with a client or at the festival I am the person who has it handled
you know how that goes in my house. my mom would never
you know how that goes in my house. my mom would never
that is a lot of code-switching
it doesn't have to be your mom's business
it doesn't have to be your mom's business
not switching, more like different rooms. the comadre room is real. the coordinator room is also real. I keep them separate on purpose
i know. yoga tomorrow and then ill be ok
i know. but my tías would find out somehow. you know how it is
he doesn't say anything which is its own thing
i know. yoga tomorrow and then ill be ok. cristina im fine
my coworker was asking about food assistance programs. her cousin just had a baby and is struggling
I can walk her through the application. I did it myself when Lupita and Mateo were small. 2013 to 2016
I am not ashamed. we needed it and we qualified and it helped. now we do not qualify and that is fine too. but I know exactly what forms to fill out
I will give her your number
send her to me. I will help
how do you come up with the menus for events. you make it look easy
I start with a spreadsheet. budget per head, dietary restrictions, seasonal availability, the venue heat situation. then I build from there
that sounds like a lot of steps
it is. but once the structure is set I can play. I did a mole-pulled pork fusion for the April booking. never done it before but the math said it would work
Colorado mole with the Oaxacan chocolate and a Texas smoke rub. I tested it twice in March. client is going to love it
i found my jeans from before gaby. they don't fit either lol
me too honestly. i put on my good jeans for the arts center last week and i was like... no
probably 35 pounds from where i want to be. maybe more
i told dr chen and she wasn't alarmed but she said with the blood sugar history we should watch it
doing my grocery run. El Bodegón first then Aldi for the cereal and snacks
can I tag along? I need dried chiles too
Aldi is on the way back right
yeah I do El Bodegón first for produce and meat, then Aldi for the staples. sometimes H-Mart after if mom needs something Korean
how did it go this morning
good. Father Miguel has been at Saint John Neumann for seven years now and I think he knows me better than my own mother on some things
he said something that unlocked the November thing. I do not want to put it in a text but I feel lighter
good. that is what he is for
seven years. I would be lost without him in that building
comadre you know what I was thinking about today? the December 2013 festival. the food tent
I think about it every December. your mom changed my life that day
she told me she saw something in you with the way you reorganized the whole tent line in 20 minutes
she said mija you are not a cook, you are an organizer. I was so embarrassed
Dona Rosa literally invented my whole second career in one sentence
mom said abuela called. she keeps asking when we're coming
I know. I've been putting $40 a month aside. I have $480 so far
2027. needs to be 2027. it's been almost nine years
I know. that's why it's not 2028
finally hit it four days in a row this week
yes. 8k. today was paco walk after folklórico so it was easy
hector got me this tracker for mother's day and i actually use it which surprised both of us
I told my coworker about you and she said you sound exhausting
I have three spreadsheets open right now so
the parish festival vendor list. and a rough budget for Lupita school clothes in September
September comes every year. I would rather have numbers in March
your coworker was right but also you are my favorite person
so what's after Caste. has the group decided
Dolores wants House of the Spirits again but I put it to a vote last night in the group chat
Pachinko won 4-2. so next month Pachinko
wasn't that on your list last year too
yes. I proposed it after we did The Warmth of Other Suns
in a Google doc. who read what, when, who proposed it. four years of entries
Saw an article about Gwinnett police reforms. What is your read on the department now?
mixed. Officer Reyes near the school has always been decent. the department now is better than the Conway years for sure
The old federal immigration-enforcement agreement -- you remember that period?
I remember it very well. people I know were scared to call 911. that cannot be how a county works
now I would call. I still do not trust every car that pulls someone over but I would call if Mateo was hurt. that is a real change
Tomas is crashing again Friday. I told him to ask you
he already texted. yes he can have the couch. he has the Friday morning Georgia State Perimeter thing anyway
he is still on track to finish the associate's?
I think so. he lives with Mom and Papa which makes it hard but he is managing
Javier said he offered to help with the truck this weekend
yes. Javier is in Buford, Tomas near Mom, you in Duluth, me here. we are basically spread across the whole county
did you do your taxes yet
yes. TurboTax Self-Employed. got the refund deposited last week
about $2,100. the earned income credit is the big piece
I don't even know if I qualify for that
with three kids you definitely do. the kids matter a lot for that credit. use TurboTax it walks you through it
[forwarded message] TOMA ESTE TE TODOS LOS DIAS Y TU DIABETES SE VA EN 30 DIAS
Mama no. mira este link del CDC en espanol. dice exactamente que los teas milagrosos no funcionan y pueden ser peligrosos con metformina
PERO DONA LUZ LO TOMA Y DICE QUE LE AYUDA
Dona Luz tiene 78 anos y sobrevive todo. eso no es evidencia. yo ya revise ese producto y lo bane de mi grupo de Facebook porque venden datos
te mando el link otra vez. guardalo por favor
good. I get my turn in August I think. $700
three years. same 7 women from church. $100 a month, $700 payout every 7 months
and you all trust each other
yes. it's been three years with no drama. Elena organizes the schedule
she was actually happy with me this time lol
ok thats actually really good!! you've been walking every morning?
four days a week minimum with paco. and no more salt at the table
he puts tajin on everything now so he's fine
she still want you on medication?
no she said keep doing what im doing and come back in june
do you ever think about the pastry school thing
sometimes. Le Cordon Bleu had a satellite program, fully funded. 2015 I think. I did the math

the program was 18 months. full time. Lupita was 3, Mateo was 1. if I was gone 8 hours a day for 18 months while Hector worked the same shift, who was with the kids? and what would I do with a pastry credential that pays $14 an hour
you actually sat down and figured that out
on the back of a napkin at the kitchen table. I cried a little and then moved on
good. the refurbished laptop they gave me finally stopped freezing on the math videos
the one from the library program?
yes. it is slow but it works. the Khan Academy stuff loads fine now
I am really doing this. math is the hard part. reading I can do. math I have to actually think
always. come before 9 I have yoga
how did you get through November. like really get through it

confession with Father Miguel the week after. long walk with you that Saturday. cooking for Sunday lunch on purpose, not just as a task. and I gave myself two weeks before I let myself make any big decisions
I learned what works for me. I cannot afford the therapy co-pay and honestly I am not sure I trust it yet anyway. so I built something that works with what I have
most of the time. I know when I need to call you. that is half of it
si mama ya rece el rosario esta manana, el misterio gozoso
BIEN MIJA. HOY ES MIERCOLES TIENES QUE IR
voy al de las 7pm con las senoras del grupo
someone posted a supplement thing in the Moms group. spent an hour removing posts and writing a pinned response
some 'metabolism reset' thing. I banned the account. 800 moms don't need that in their feed
also I had to review 30 posts in the folklórico group about the April showcase logistics. two hours of my morning gone
Someone on the book club thread asked if you two had been to any marches. I said yes, you and Cristina were there with me in June 2020.
that whole week was something. Hector was nervous for me to go but I had to
You both showed up. That meant a lot.
it was the right thing. one time but I meant it
I heard a commentator say Latino voters are shifting right and I immediately thought of you
yes and no. my cousins Edgar and Roberto both voted differently in 2024. Edgar owns a small business and got hit by costs. Roberto just follows whatever the group chat says

and neither of them is me. I hate when they say the Latino vote like it is one thing. we have been here different amounts of time, different countries, different situations. the block framing drives me crazy
someone in the parish group is asking about event planners for a quince in November. I gave them your number
I am not really a professional
Maria you planned Gaby quince for 140 people under $4,000 and made her tia cry with a surprise waltz. yes you are
same skill. I told them October 2024, call the reference
cómo te fue con doña lupe
bien mamá. sentí el peso ese en los hombros que te digo
sí. ya me quedo más tranquila hasta septiembre
its prediabetic range technically but she said given my history its actually better than she expected
your history meaning with the pregnancies?
yeah. both times. and my mom has it so im watching
ok well 5.8 is not 7. you're fine
i need to cut the pan dulce at sunday lunch lol
you're not going to do that
book club tonight — Keisha is bringing wine again
good. i'll do one glass. two if Isabel Allende makes me cry again
it's Caste tonight not House of the Spirits
Caste might be worse honestly. still just one glass though
remember Jessamyn's bachelorette when you did the edible
never again. that was 2022 and i'm still embarrassed
you literally just sat on the couch and watched Coco twice
I drove past the old adult learning center today. made me think of Sister Annette
I think about her a lot. especially with the GED stuff starting again. she was the first person who ever told me I was smart
March 2021. I still keep her card in my wallet. the one she gave me at my first ESL certificate
that is a beautiful thing to carry
she would be so annoyed I waited this long to go back to school
did you ever replace the water heater from last year
yes. December. I put it on the Lowe's card, the 18-month zero interest offer
just for that. I do not carry credit cards normally. too easy to dig a hole. but 18 months with no interest and I know exactly how much each payment needs to be, that I can manage
I have a spreadsheet. if I miss the deadline even by one day the interest they add back is brutal. so I set a calendar alert for November
what are you making for sunday
pozole but im doing it with chicken thighs and a mole-chipotle base instead of pork
omg that sounds good but abuela would have opinions
abuela is in guanajuato lol. also the base is still from scratch, guajillo and mulato chiles
can i request the tamales for next sunday
last night was heavy but good
Fatima's take on the caste parallels was the best part. four years and she still brings a perspective nobody else has
Dolores wants to do House of the Spirits again after Caste
that will be her third time pushing that
fourth. she started before Fatima joined
ok fine four. i actually love it too just don't tell her that
the arts center director asked what motivates you. what did you say
I said the same thing I always say. family first, faith underneath everything, and then the work that connects me to the community
do you actually believe that or is it a speech
both. but mostly believe. when those three things are in order I am okay. when one is off I can feel it immediately
which one is off right now
none right now. which is rare. I am trying to notice it
46 forms today. 46. and that was just the Sunday crowd after the 12:30
nice?? Javier I did 140 total last year between the spring table and the Camp Creek festival and you just say nice
I am going to put you on the Camp Creek table in the fall. you owe me one
Tio Roberto made a comment at Sunday lunch again. I said something this time.
I said Roberto that is not okay at this table. he got quiet. Adriana almost choked on her horchata
Good. Every time you say something it chips away a little.
it is exhausting but I cannot just sit there. especially with the kids listening
That is the right call. Always.
Mom was going on about the political stuff after Mass today. you know, the usual
I know. I love Mom but I think the bishops have made it simpler than it is. life and health and circumstance are complicated
I said I pray about it and I think it is between a woman and God. she changed the subject
hey where does mom go when she has a bad patch. is there a doctor nearby
she goes to Dr. Torres at the same place i go. Gwinnett Community Clinic on Grayson Pkwy
they do sliding scale so it's not full price
like $20 for me. depends on your income verification
ok maybe i should switch. my copays at that urgent care are insane
call them and ask about the process. I've been going there 6 years, dr chen is really good
what health plan are you on
Hector and I are on an ACA bronze plan. $412 a month with the subsidy
the deductible is $7,500 though. so if anything big happens we're basically paying out of pocket until then
Peach Care. no premium for them. that part is actually great
I should look into that for mine too
I told you Fernando was not to be trusted
you told me that last week too and I didn't listen
watch them try to fix this in 3 episodes
ok but Valentina's arc this season is genuinely good
ok yes. I'll give them that
how is the library thing going
good. I started in January and I am about 10 weeks in. math is the part I dread. I keep redoing the fractions module
reading I could probably test today. science is in the middle, I am not worried about it
yes. the question is when. math is what is standing between me and the test date
Dr. Chen wants to keep the metformin the same for now. A1C is 7.1. foot looks better, no new ulcer
thank God. last year that ulcer took forever to heal
four months. I cooked diabetic-friendly every Sunday for four months straight. Mama finally got used to the brown rice
she told me last week she actually likes it now
do not tell her I heard that. she will stop pretending she does it for me
did you see tio roberto sharing those posts again
yes. I left a comment with the AP article and then stepped away
you are more patient than me
I just think we lose people when we fight dirty. I voted Harris because I believe in it but I also understand why Edgar thought differently, he has got the landscaping business and the costs hit him
I am not there yet lol
you do not have to be. I just cannot hate people I eat Sunday lunch with
ok I'm serious this year. you need to retake the test
I know. so the third time you'll pass
I don't have panic attacks exactly but I freeze on lane changes
Hector's been offering. it's just the scheduling with his job
I can drive you around. I'm off Thursdays
you are too nice to me
What is your position on the Medicaid expansion bill? It is back in committee.
I support it. I am in the gap right now. I know exactly what the expansion would do
I want a real path. I am also realistic that unmanaged crossings hurt the people who are trying to do it right. I do not have a bumper sticker answer on that one
That is a harder position to hold.
harder than both teams want to hear, yes. I am used to it
all the time. I haven't been back since Mateo was two
eight and a half. June 2017 was the last time
was that when Lupita started asking why you speak differently to abuela
yes. and Mateo barely remembers it. which honestly breaks my heart a little
I saw the Instagram post for the arts center spring event. the reel with the Selena song
Bidi Bidi Bom Bom. always works. engagement went up 40 percent when I started using her songs
classic. are you doing the mariachi again for the April thing
yes. Trio Aguila from Norcross, I have been booking them for client events for three years now. they know my timeline by heart
you have a whole roster now
I keep a sheet. it took a few bad experiences to learn who shows up on time
FELIZ CUMPLEANOS MIJA. QUE DIOS TE BENDIGA. 35 ANOS. RECUERDO EL DIA QUE NACISTE EN LEON
Gracias mama. voy para alla despues de misa
YA HICE EL POZOLE. LLEGA TEMPRANO
Keisha said something on Twitter about the book ban stuff. did you see it
I am not on Twitter. never got into it. I heard about it from her on WhatsApp
you are literally on everything else
Facebook, Instagram for the center, WhatsApp for the three group chats. Twitter is too fast and mean. I had Snapchat years ago, deleted it
how's Lupita doing with the quince planning
she has 18 months of opinions already lol. she wants deep blue and white. no pink
gaby was the same. they know what they want
she turned 14 in February. I can't believe she's in 9th grade. clarinet is going well at least
tornado as usual. got a goal last saturday which helped his mood
mija tu prima rosa dice que la vacuna del covid hace daño ahora
yo ya tengo tres dosis y el año pasado me puse la actualizada también
CDC dice que es segura. te mando el link del CDC en español
y a los niños ya les puse todas sus vacunas. todo bien
Are you covered for health insurance right now?
Hector has the kids and himself through the HVAC company. I am in between. I make too much for the county program and not enough to buy in without subsidy. classic gap
The coverage gap. Georgia still has not expanded.
I know. I am a self-employed contractor who does not show up as employed on most of their forms. it is a weird place to be
That is a real policy failure not a personal one.
I know. does not make the dentist bill smaller
remember when mateo was a baby and you went through that really quiet phase
i was thinking about that. i had something similar after my second
do you think you ever got support for that
no. just pushed through. hector was working all hours, nobody really noticed
you were basically a ghost for like six months
i know. at the time i thought it was just exhaustion
i think now it was probably more than that
did you do the candle for abuelo today
yes, this morning. got a new votive from the dollar store on Tuesday, the old one was basically a puddle
I love that you do that every year
it is on the altar next to la Virgen. he would have been 84
I put a fresh photo too. the one from his last birthday in Mexico
Tomas needs a ride to the Perimeter campus Tuesday. I cannot do it from Buford in time
I will ask Adriana. she is closer to Duluth
Javier you know for a family that does not have cars we move a lot of people around
I have a car. you and Tomas are the problem
good now. that thing in December was rough but he's back to himself
i still can't believe that happened on the bus
I know. Keisha really helped me understand how to talk to him about it
thinking about buying. how did you even start
FHA loan. 2017. We put 3.5 percent down, $178,000 purchase price
that was how much out of pocket
like $6,200 plus closing. we had saved two years
where do you even start with that
HUD counselor first. they're free. and check your credit six months before you're serious
Zillow says $265,000. but who knows. we refinanced in 2020 when rates were low
$1,485 with escrow. that's taxes and insurance in there
and how much do you still owe
the 2020 refi helped a lot. and we bought before prices went insane
last night was so good. when is the next one
I'm thinking May. i want to do a mole night. three different moles
you say that every time and then you bring Keisha and she never warns me how many people shes inviting
when did you get serious about baking
at the Oaxacan night she brought two. i scaled the tlayudas for 6 and we ended up with 9
always. I actually got a full scholarship to the Gwinnett Tech pastry program when Mateo was a baby
ok but the tlayudas were still perfect
wait what? you never told me that
I didn't mail the application in the end. Hector's truck broke, mom's diagnosis came in the same month, Mateo was barely sleeping
I did the math. it didn't add up. the hours, the commute, the kids. it made sense not to go
sometimes. I still have the application. it's in my filing cabinet
just finished the call with Flor. she wants Lupita to visit Monterrey this summer. I said we will see
Hector's family is there. his mom is 66 and she is not going to be able to make the trip forever. I want the kids to know her
Flor always asks me how the kids are when she sees me on the screen
she asks after everyone. every Sunday after Mass, same time. it is our thing
ten years ago this spring you were studying for the civics test
2016. I still remember standing in that room in Atlanta. I was shaking
you drove me and you cried more than I did
the proudest I have ever felt. including both of my children being born. I felt like I earned that day inch by inch
you should do that catering thing for real
like seriously. you already have a client list
maybe 10 events a year to start. baptisms, bridal stuff. i'd need a commercial kitchen license
Gwinnett County has a cottage food thing too
i've looked at that. baked goods only, $50k cap. my mole takes 8 hours so it won't qualify
i research everything. just not the right time yet. GED first
Did you see the bill they are moving in the Georgia legislature? bathroom restrictions.
I saw. I do not fully understand all the pieces but my gut says just be kind and let people figure out their own lives
That is a decent starting point.
I still have questions. but my questions are not reasons to make things harder for someone. that part I know
Honestly that is further along than a lot of people I know.
my mom would not agree with me on this one. but I am not my mom on everything
what do you actually want. like in your life. forget the logistics
I want my kids to be okay. I want Hector not to work himself to death. I want my mom's feet to stop hurting
those are all for other people
ok. I want to see my grandmother before it's too late. I want to dance at the festival in July
I want more evenings where the light does that thing it does over Stone Mountain at sunset. that's enough. beauty is enough
my mom was asking about your dad. how is Don Ramon doing
his back is the same. thirty years at Green Horizons and his body is paying for it now. he was crew lead at the end but still outside every day
crew lead is something. he worked for that
yes. he finished sixth grade in Mexico and then built a whole career here with no English for the first ten years. I do not take that lightly
Mama got to eighth grade. she cleaned houses until her feet gave out. between the two of them they did everything for us and I want to honor that
I was telling my friend about growing up and realized you basically raised me for like three years
you were the easy one. Tomas was the hard one
somebody had to. Mama was working nights at the hotel and Papa had two jobs
no. that is just who I became
mamá todo bien, la presión bajó, no necesito pastillas por ahora
tu tía rosa tomó pastillas por la presión y la dejaron con mareos
eleventh grade. my mom had my youngest brother and got really sick after. somebody had to be home
